system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs Docker (apt or yum source), adds a specified user to the docker group, and ensures the docker daemon is running and enabled at boot.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs Docker (apt or yum source), adds a specified user to the docker group, and ensures the docker daemon is running and enabled at boot.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure Docker
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  vars:
    docker_user: "{{ docker_user | default('docker') }}"
  tasks:
    - name: Install required system packages
      package:
        name:
          - apt-transport-https
          - ca-certificates
          - curl
          - gnupg
          - lsb-release
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Add Docker GPG apt key
      apt_key:
        url: https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ ansible_distribution | lower }}/gpg
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Add Docker repository
      apt_repository:
        repo: deb https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ ansible_distribution | lower }} {{ ansible_distribution_release }} stable
        state: present
        filename: docker
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Install Docker CE
      package:
        name: docker-ce
        state: present

    - name: Ensure Docker service is started and enabled
      systemd:
        name: docker
        state: started
        enabled: yes

    - name: Create docker group
      group:
        name: docker
        state: present

    - name: Add user to docker group
      user:
        name: "{{ docker_user }}"
        groups: docker
        append: yes

    - name: Reset ssh connection to apply group changes
      meta: reset_connection
